purpose: Bind exact public-language atoms to explicit epistemic, provenance, support, review and publication records without treating structural validity as truth or authority.
hash_contract: sha256 over the exact UTF-8 bytes of each statement with no whitespace or Unicode normalisation
publication_rule: approved-by-governance-record is a recorded disposition only; a machine-valid ledger does not authenticate the authority record or determine publishability
truth_rule: support_state records an assessment; it does not establish truth
atomicity_rule: each atomic claim has one epistemic_class, one provenance_role, one support_state and one publication_disposition; a source sentence may reference multiple atomic claims
challenge_rule: every atomic claim binds a counterclaim and a falsifier or explicit governance revision condition
lineage_rule: replacement edges are directed, acyclic, review-bound and preserve both immutable claims
